title: Commodity collection model extension — depth-3 obligations (HALT-FOR-REVIEW GATE)
gate: HALT-FOR-REVIEW: depth-3 commodity model gate — pp-012 (P-7) evidence plus this increment's real-object characterisation suite attach here; Sam reviews the model before any m3 commodity page (pp-022..pp-028 pages that collect it) proceeds (SIBLING-SET-PLAN §9 rule 5)
recipe: sets/live-animals/docs/add-a-collection.md (steps 1-2: manifest group declarations + grouped bindings only — no pages this increment). Depth 3 has NO recipe (§8 G-B): SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.1/§3.2/FD-9 are the script for the nesting; the live depth-2 exemplar is sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/commodities/identifiers.js (unitRecord within commodityLine + allowListed with projection group).

filesToTouch.what: Exports the level-1 group and its 10 scalar member leaves, all fresh UUIDs, pure data (no copy, no IO at module load — obligation-purity). `commodityLines` group: { id: <uuid>, name: 'commodityLines', requires: { minEntries: 1, errorCode: 'obligation.commodityLines.atLeastOne' } } — NO status, NO applyTo (structural group; pattern sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/commodities/lines.js commodityLine). Members, each { id: <uuid>, name, within: commodityLines (OBJECT IDENTITY — import the const, never a string), status }: commoditySelection (mandatory — the code picked in search; maps to commodityCode + ref-data-derived commodityDescription), numberOfPackages (mandatory), packageType (mandatory), quantity (mandatory), quantityType (mandatory), netWeight (mandatory), controlledAtmosphereContainer (optional — legacy: no NotNull anywhere), finishedOrPropagated (optional — legacy conditionality not modelled as a gate, see openQuestions), intendedForFinalUsers (optional), testAndTrial (optional). Names are path-safe camelCase (no . [ ]) — they are per-instance answers keys (answers.commodityLines[i].netWeight) and DOM field names.

Exports the level-2 group + 3 leaves. `species` group: { id: <uuid>, name: 'species', within: commodityLines (imported from ./lines.js by identity), requires: { minEntries: 1, errorCode: 'obligation.species.atLeastOne' } } — every commodity line needs at least one species. Members within species: eppoCode (mandatory — THE join key, Open Q 1 ruling), genusAndSpecies (mandatory, ref-data-derived scientific name), speciesId (optional — internal ref-data id, persisted for round-trip only, never joined on).

Exports the level-3 group + 2 leaves. `varieties` group: { id: <uuid>, name: 'varieties', within: species (imported from ./species.js by identity) } — NO requires (optional collection, zero instances is complete). Members within varieties: variety (mandatory — store the variety ID not the display label, Open Q 2 ruling); varietyClass (status 'optional', applyTo: allowListed(eppoCode, classApplicableSpecies, varieties, [varietyClassReason]) — gate obligation is the species-level eppoCode leaf, values resolve LAZILY at gate execution from sets/plant-products/services/commodities (pp-014's per-species class-applicability lookup, e.g. a classApplicableSpecies() thunk exported by that service's index.js), projection group is the varieties group (deeper field gated on shallower value — exact pattern of allowListed(commodityCode, passportCommodities, unitRecord, …) in live-animals identifiers.js), reason { code: 'obligation.varietyClass.applicable.becauseClassApplicableSpecies', explanation: … }. Values CLASS_I | CLASS_II | EXTRA_CLASS; null when N/A (out of scope → engine wipes just that field in that instance).

The commodities feature binding bundle — authored NOW, registered in journeys/linear/features/evaluation.js by pp-023 (see notes: registering before a page owns commodityLines would fail buildDispatch boot coverage). feature('commodities', [...]) with three group descriptors { field, token, obligation } for line/species/variety, then grouped() bindings: chain [line] for the 10 commodityLines leaves; chain [line, speciesGroup] for eppoCode/genusAndSpecies/speciesId; chain [line, speciesGroup, varietyGroup] for variety/varietyClass — binding depth MUST equal the within chain (bridge/fulfilment-bindings.js contract). Import obligations from ../../../../obligations/sections/commodities/*.js so binding and manifest share object identity. Export the bundle (named export, same shape as live-animals feature evaluation bundles).

The gate's characterisation evidence with REAL objects (pp-012 proved the platform with a synthetic manifest; this suite proves THIS model). Set-as-fixture composition (pattern: pp-012's harness / the bridge characterisation tests, recon §6). NOTE the post-P-9 seam signatures: every configure*/build* now takes setId as its FIRST argument, so this suite calls configureObligationSet(setId, …), configureFulfilmentRegistry(setId, …) and buildDispatch(setId, …) with a fixture set id. It composes exactly ONE set, so FD-17's sole-registered-set fallback resolves currentSetId() and no withSetContext plumbing is needed. Compose: configureObligationSet(setId, …) with a fixture manifest namespace { obligations: [the 15 real commodity obligations], groups: derived via the index.js filter formula, policy: minimal FD-7 shape }, configureFulfilmentRegistry(setId, …) with the real commodities binding bundle from features/commodities/evaluation.js, buildDispatch(setId, …) with one fixture owner page { id: 'fixture-commodity-owner', slug: 'fixture-commodity-owner', collects: ['commodityLines'] }. Tests: (1) registration accepts the depth-3 chain (boot assertions pass); (2) NEGATIVE — a grouped binding whose groups array is [line, speciesGroup] for a varieties leaf is rejected (depth-mismatch guard); (3) appendEntryAt/updateEntryAt/removeEntryAt at ['commodityLines', i, 'species', j, 'varieties'] round-trip an entry at depth 3 and renumber snapshot-locally on remove; (4) NEGATIVE — out-of-range/non-integer parent index writes are refused (no phantom instance; engine isValidIndex + recipe §4.7 guard); (5) per-instance scope + wipe: varietyClass in scope only when the owning species' eppoCode is in the class-applicability list; taking the eppoCode out of the list wipes varietyClass IN THAT INSTANCE only, sibling instances untouched; (6) collection-complete rollup: line complete iff species floor met and every species instance complete; varieties group with zero entries does NOT block completeness; a varieties instance missing `variety` DOES; (7) dispatch coverage inheritance: pageOfObligation resolves every member leaf (all three depths) to fixture-commodity-owner. Configure the set-keyed seam registries around the suite exactly as pp-012's harness does — post-P-9 these are per-set registries (setKeyed), not module-level single slots, so the old 'Vitest file isolation dodges the singletons' reasoning no longer applies; FD-10 keeps this a separate file for readability and independent failure attribution.

Extend the pp-008 mapper: answers.commodityLines[] → dto.commodity.commodityComplement[] (SCHEMA-DESIGN §1.1). Per line: commoditySelection → commodityCode, commodityDescription derived from sets/plant-products/services/commodities lookup (code → leaf description; never typed, never stored in answers); measures 1:1 (numberOfPackages, packageType, quantity, quantityType, netWeight, controlledAtmosphereContainer, finishedOrPropagated, intendedForFinalUsers, testAndTrial); uniqueComplementId echoed from the entry's passthrough key when present, omitted for new lines (server assigns on first save); species[] → { eppoCode, genusAndSpecies, speciesId, varieties: [{ variety, varietyClass }] }. Whole-document write (replaceFulfilment is whole-document PUT, pp-008). NEVER emit transient UI keys (add-species-<id>); no invented DTO properties — a field with no backend home gets an omission assertion, not a mapping.

Inverse: dto.commodity.commodityComplement[] → answers.commodityLines[] with the nested species[].varieties[] arrays; commodityCode → commoditySelection; uniqueComplementId stored on each line entry under a single passthrough key (decision recorded in notes) so to-dto can echo it and pp-025's remove-by-uniqueComplementId has the key available; commodityDescription NOT rehydrated into answers (ref-data-derived, recomputed at save).

Add: (1) 3-deep round-trip — from-dto(to-dto(answers)) preserves lines/species/varieties nesting, order and every leaf; (2) commodityDescription derived from the commodities service for a known fixture code; (3) uniqueComplementId passthrough — present survives the round trip, absent stays absent in to-dto output; (4) omission assertions — no add-species-<id> or other transient key ever appears in the DTO; varietyClass null when N/A serialises as null/omitted per the pp-008 house choice; (5) empty commodityLines → commodityComplement [] (not undefined) consistent with pp-008's empty-document shape.

Obligation purity holds: no copy, labels, options, route names or IO at module load in any section file; the varietyClass allowlist resolves lazily at gate execution from the pp-014 commodities service.
